steps.label: scroll-fönster
steps.js: () => { const before = window.scrollY; window.scrollTo(0, 600); const after = window.scrollY; const se = document.scrollingElement; const readMore = document.querySelector('[data-testid="event-card-read-more"]'); const r = readMore ? readMore.getBoundingClientRect() : null; return { windowScrollBefore: before, windowScrollAfter: after, docScrollTop: se ? se.scrollTop : null, docScrollHeight: se ? se.scrollHeight : null, docClientHeight: se ? se.clientHeight : null, readMoreTop: r ? Math.round(r.top) : null, readMoreVisible: r ? (r.top >= 0 && r.top < window.innerHeight) : null }; }

steps.js: () => Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('button, [role="button"]')).filter(e => { const r = e.getBoundingClientRect(); return r.width > 0 && r.height > 0; }).map(e => ({ aria: e.getAttribute('aria-label'), top: Math.round(e.getBoundingClientRect().top) })).slice(0, 10)
